headline: B&Q 🍔 and FIVE GUYS 🍟 CAUGHT 🍑 short STROKING 💰 their STAFF below MINIMUM WAGE 😩
text:
B&Q 🛠️ and Five Guys 🍔 are among HUNDREDS 🏬 of UK firms NAMED 🏷️ and SHAMED 😤 by the government for paying STAFF below the MINIMUM WAGE 📉!! More than SIX HUNDRED 🧮 employers got ORDERED 📜 to cough up the outstanding WAGES 💵 with a juicy FOUR MILLION POUNDS 💷 returned straight to the WORKERS 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 according to the Department for Business and Trade 🏛️!! The same firms also swallowed hefty PENALTIES 🏋️ worth SEVEN MILLION POUNDS 💰 in total!! B&Q 🪛 claimed the underpayments were totally UNINTENTIONAL 😇 and came from weird CALCULATIONS 🧮 involving geographical ALLOWANCES 🗺️ while Five Guys 🍟 blamed technical DIFFERENCES 🔧 in how payroll REGULATIONS 📋 were APPLIED 🌀!!

The full LIST 📋 of SIX HUNDRED AND FIFTY EIGHT 🏪 businesses includes SHOPS 🛍️ restaurants 🍽️ nurseries 🍼 social care providers 🏥 and even a handful of NHS TRUSTS 🩺!! The underpayment PERIODS 📅 stretch all the way from TWO THOUSAND THIRTEEN 📆 to TWO THOUSAND TWENTY FIVE ⏳ depending on each EMPLOYER 🧑‍💼!! Minimum wage sits at TWELVE POUNDS SEVENTY ONE 💷 for anyone TWENTY ONE and OVER 🧓 while EIGHTEEN to TWENTY year olds get TEN POUNDS EIGHTY FIVE 💵 and under EIGHTEENS or APPRENTICES 🧑‍🎓 scrape by on EIGHT QUID 🪙!! B&Q 🛠️ underpaid a whopping FOUR THOUSAND FIVE HUNDRED AND THIRTY WORKERS 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 a total exceeding FOUR HUNDRED AND FIFTY SIX THOUSAND POUNDS 💸!!

B&Q 🪛 said in a slick STATEMENT 📢 the shortfalls were purely UNINTENTIONAL 😇 relating to calculations with those geographical ALLOWANCES 🗺️ that get paid on top of minimum HOURLY RATES ⏰!! All the affected COLLEAGUES 👥 were quickly PAID IN FULL 💰 back in JULY TWO THOUSAND TWENTY FIVE 🌞!! Five Guys 🍔 named as owing over FIFTY FOUR THOUSAND POUNDS 💵 to THREE THOUSAND SIX HUNDRED AND NINETY NINE STAFF 🧑‍🍳 said technical differences in payroll rules led to the SLIP UPS 🛠️ which only got spotted during an HMRC REVIEW 🔎!!

We worked closely and TRANSPARENTLY 🤝 with HMRC throughout the whole process and have now made ALL REQUIRED PAYMENTS 💸 to every affected current and former EMPLOYEE 👩‍💼 the burger chain insisted 🍔!! Epsom and St Helier Hospital Group 🏥 failed to pay over ONE HUNDRED AND TWENTY THREE THOUSAND POUNDS 💷 to SEVENTY FIVE WORKERS 🧑‍⚕️ with the underpayments blamed on SALARY SACRIFICE SCHEMES 💼 that have since been completely CHANGED 🔄!! St George's University Hospitals in Wandsworth 🏥 underpaid FIFTY FIVE STAFF 🧑‍⚕️ due to similar salary sacrifice schemes plus technical hiccups with London WEIGHTING ALLOWANCES 🏙️ and the group has now tweaked its processes after the HMRC AUDIT 🕵️!!

The Trust covering both hospital GROUPS 🏥 now disputes that ANY staff were actually underpaid at all 🙅‍♂️ while a spokesperson for Norfolk Community Health and Care NHS Trust admitted APPRENTICES 🧑‍🎓 were inadvertently short changed between TWO THOUSAND NINETEEN and TWO THOUSAND TWENTY THREE 📆!! Their base pay met contracted HOURS ⏰ but meetings handovers and time spent changing into UNIFORM 👕 somehow never got counted in the totals so policies have now been updated 🛠️!! Several NURSING HOMES 🛏️ and multiple CHILDCARE PROVIDERS 🧸 also made the naughty LIST 📋 of shame!!

Business Secretary Jonathan Reynolds 🧑‍💼 said the government is DEAD SET 🛑 on stamping out any SHORT CHANGING 💸 of staff because the best businesses know looking after WORKERS 👷 isn't just the right thing but the SMART THING too 🧠!! Kate Dearden minister for the future of work warned that underpaying staff is straight up ILLEGAL 🚫 and workers will never foot the bill for bosses failing to follow the RULES 📜!! Every employer should double check their PAYROLL 🧾 right now and reach out to ACAS if they need extra SUPPORT 🆘 she added while the list marks the first big NAMING ROUND 🔊 since the new Fair Work Agency launched in APRIL under the Employment Rights Act ⚖️!!
